snippet.title: Dune: Awakening — Lost Harvest DLC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Lost Harvest DLC is now available! Lost Harvest brings a new storyline, new vehicle, new building pieces, cosmetic skins, and more.

Read our full blog where we dive into all the new features: https://bit.ly/Chapter2andLostHarvest

More Dune Man building pieces are coming: https://duneawakening.com/news/regarding-the-dune-man-building-pieces/

Dune: Awakening is out now on Steam: https://bit.ly/DuneAwakeningSteam

Dune: Awakening is an Open World Survival RPG where you can fully immerse yourself in the epic world of Dune. Alone or with friends, explore a vast open world Arrakis, survive the sandworms, build a home, craft an ornithopter, and unravel the mystery of the missing Fremen.

#duneawakening #dune
